network_enforcement: The release checker makes no network request. Its Lean replay invokes check_validation.sh, whose Lean subprocesses run through Bubblewrap with --unshare-net and a read-only host root. This deliberately reuses the pinned warm cache and is nonrelease evidence.
scope_boundary: Fail-closed release reconciliation of current structured authority with provisional proof and validation receipts plus a fresh narrow trust-level-zero Lean replay. It cannot supply dependency acceptance, graph migration, H0/R0 review, cold offline hermetic evidence, complete provenance/TCB/SBOM closure, independent verification, a deterministic release bundle, or master acceptance.
